section.title: Trapping a Python Exception
section.para: You want to handle a Python exception in Rexx code.

How it works. A Python exception is the Rexx condition SYNTAX 98.900, so signal on syntax traps it, as any Rexx error. Its message is Python error: and Python's own. The condition object carries more, in its ADDITIONAL Array: additional[2] is Python's traceback, as text, and additional[3] the exception itself, a Python object, whose type and arguments can be looked at.

The other way works too: .py~raise(.py~KeyError, "missing") raises a Python exception from Rexx code, and a Python exception that goes through Rexx code back to Python is raised there as itself ( uses it to end a sequence).
See also Reference, Errors and Conditions.
